page.title: Address Masters
page.subtitle: Thai province / district / sub-district geocodes. Pick a province to see its districts, and a district to see its sub-districts.

dataset.title: Title (Land Dept)
dataset.titleHint: Used for title-deed addresses. Includes historical and merged provinces, non-numeric codes, and may leave postcodes blank.
dataset.dopaHint: Used for property location addresses (civil registration). Separate dataset — editing it does not change the Title master.

hints.code: Up to {{max}} characters. Not necessarily numeric.
hints.codeImmutable: The code is the key other records point at and cannot be changed.
hints.postcode: Optional — leave blank when the dataset has none.

validation.namesRequired: Both the Thai and English names are required.
